verdict.rationale: The firm publishes a named startup program (Prarambh) with stated structural terms — a 12-stage/10-week cohort, eligibility criteria (registered ≥1 year), and mentorship/beta-testing support — on its own pages, satisfying the "named program with stated terms" branch of the story. However, none of the terms are fee-related (no deferred fees, no fixed-fee formation pricing, no mention of cost/fee structure for participants). Missing for 10: any deferred-fee or fixed-fee pricing details, explicit fee-transparency statements for startup clients.
